note: The agreed rerank policy: exact-tier entries are never reordered or crossed, only the non-exact entries of block 0 are reranked, a query whose whole text is an identifier or literal is not reranked, and the candidate text leads with path:line and a name line. The local ONNX reranker no longer spins idle threads and runs smaller sub-batches. A benchmark-only pool export is read from AFT_RERANK_POOL_EXPORT. search.rerank stays off by default, so with the shipped configuration no ranked row can move: every reference row must stay byte-identical. The ranking effect with a reranker enabled is measured report-only in .cortexkit/alfonso/scratch/rerank-benchmark-report.md.
